svg.text: A database pod moves between nodes and keeps its data
cordon the node + delete inventory-db-0: the StatefulSet recreates it on the other node, and the same PVC mounts the same NFS directory.
local-path would pin the volume to one node's disk.
These PVs are NFS directories served by master,
so kubelet on either node can mount them.
The PVC belongs to the pod's name, not to a node.
